notes: Quantum Computing Inc. 10-K FY2025. Filing reviewed for J-Book-grounded language. Key finding: the 10-K does NOT name any specific Pentagon Program Element (PE) numbers, named DoD programs (e.g., AFRL Quantum Networking, Skyborg, SDA Tracking Layer, Project Maven), or specific program-of-record contracts. Government exposure is described only in generic forward-aspirational language ('anticipated future revenues from the U.S. government are expected to result from contracts awarded under various U.S. government programs'). Reported FY2025 revenue is only $682 thousand vs. $373 thousand prior year — i.e., the company is effectively pre-revenue and the entire narrative is forward-looking. The J-Book divergence pattern (named PE that the Pentagon has zeroed) cannot be directly applied because the company has not named PEs. Mode B (implied verification) claims dominate: (a) assertion of forward DoD revenue without any booked DoD contracts, (b) aerospace/defense application claims for products with no disclosed DoD customers, (c) acquisition-driven rollup narrative (Luminar Semiconductor $110M, NuCrypt, QPhoton, Freedom Photonics, Optogration) at a multi-billion market cap. The Northrop Grumman mention is a jointly-held patent between Northrop and Freedom Photonics (LSI subsidiary), not a contract.

AZ Chips Facility ... the Company is in the planning stages for another higher volume manufacturing facility, which we sometimes refer to as FAB 2.

claims.claim_text: QCi acquired Luminar Semiconductor, Inc. (LSI) for $110.0 million in February 2026 via Section 363 bankruptcy stalking-horse sale.
claims.subject: Quantum Computing Inc.
claims.source_quote: On December 15, 2025, the Company entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement ... with Luminar Technologies, Inc. ... and Luminar Semiconductor, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the Target), pursuant to which ... the Company agreed to acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of the Target ... for a total purchase price of $110.0 million in cash. ... The Seller, together with certain of its subsidiaries, is a debtor in a voluntary Chapter 11 case ... the Company was designated as the stalking horse bidder ... The Transaction was completed on February 2, 2026.
